common.errorBody: We couldn't load this view. Please try again.
common.name: Name
common.noEvent: Choose an event to get started
common.noEventBody: An owner can create an event. Its orders, tickets and stock will appear here.
common.clearSearch: Try another search or clear your filters.
common.permissionBody: Your account has access to counter operations, tickets, orders and the queue.

login.title:
A little space.
Everything in order.
login.body: Your events, counter and queue, together in one calm workspace.
login.signInBody: Sign in with your approved staff Google account.
login.restricted: Access is limited to approved team members.
login.setupBody: The database connection will be configured later. Follow the setup guide in the project README when you're ready.
login.footer: Made for the moments behind the scenes.

dashboard.title: A clear view of your day
dashboard.description: A live overview of the selected event.
dashboard.chartDescription: Paid orders, grouped by hour in Vietnam time.
dashboard.noSalesBody: Paid orders will populate this chart and your product breakdown.
dashboard.missingCosts: Some sold items have no unit cost. Profit and margin will remain incomplete; historical cost snapshots are not backfilled.
dashboard.opsDescription: Keep an eye on the queue and help the next person get started.
dashboard.queueEmptyBody: New waiting tickets will appear here.
dashboard.quickCounterBody: Add items, capture details and get things moving.
dashboard.lowStockBody: {count} inventory items are low, out, or missing a prepared count.
dashboard.allClearBody: Use the counter to register your next ticket.

events.title: Events
events.description: A shared foundation for every session and business unit.
events.name: Event name
events.prefixHelp: Uppercase letters and numbers. Locked after the first ticket.
events.capacityHelp: Leave blank for no capacity limit.
events.emptyBody: Create an event to organize tickets, orders and inventory.
events.archiveConfirm: Change this event's status? Counter registration is only available for active events.

products.title: Products & price list
products.description: A clear catalogue, with prices that preserve your sales history.
products.costHelp: Leave blank if unknown. Zero means a confirmed zero cost.
products.lockedHelp: To change the price, create a new SKU and deactivate the old one.
products.deactivateConfirm: Deactivate this SKU? Existing orders will keep their original details.
products.emptyBody: Run the catalogue seed or add your first product.

counter.title: At the counter
counter.description: A few details, and they're ready to begin.
counter.emptyBody: Tap a product to add it to the order.
counter.ticketOptional: Orders can also be created without a ticket.
counter.eventClosed: This event is not active. Select an active event to register an order.
counter.activeProductsEmpty: No active products for this event.
counter.detailsHint: Add any details the team needs for this item.

tickets.title: Tickets
tickets.description: Every person, from their first hello to their finished piece.
tickets.emptyBody: Register a ticket at the counter to begin.
tickets.cancelConfirm: Cancel this ticket? It will disappear from the queue. The linked order and payment stay separate.
tickets.printHelp: The counter records print requests. Your browser cannot confirm whether paper was printed.
tickets.thankYou: Thank you. Enjoy making something yours.
tickets.noItems: No active items linked to this ticket.

queue.title: Live queue
queue.description: A little order for a smooth flow.
queue.displayTitle: Make a little. Enjoy a lot.
queue.displaySubtitle: Find your number and follow along.
queue.noEvent: Select an event in the workspace before opening the display.

orders.title: Orders
orders.description: Workshop and F&B together, with a clear payment trail.
orders.emptyBody: Create an order at the counter.
orders.refundConfirm: Mark this order as refunded? Revenue will be removed. Stock is not automatically returned.
orders.cancelConfirm: Cancel this Unpaid order? Its stock usage will be reversed.
orders.deleteConfirm: Archive this order? It will remain in the audit trail, leave revenue reports, and reverse stock usage.
orders.locked: Paid, Refunded and Cancelled orders cannot be edited.
orders.removeConfirm: Remove this item from the Unpaid order? Its stock usage will be reversed.

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.description: Know what's prepared, what's used and what needs attention.
inventory.missing: Some items have no prepared stock count. Enter counts to get reliable availability alerts.
inventory.emptyBody: Add supplies and connect products to the stock they consume.
inventory.mappingBody: Set how much of a supply one sold product consumes. Changes apply to future order items.
inventory.preparedHelp: Blank means not entered; 0 means none prepared.
inventory.disableConfirm: Disable this mapping for future orders? Existing usage snapshots will stay intact.

costs.title: Event costs
costs.description: Record operating expenses for the selected event.
costs.accountingHelp: Record operating expenses only. Avoid logging stock purchases already included in product unit costs, which would count the same cost twice.

settings.title: Access & settings
settings.description: Only approved Google accounts can enter this workspace.
settings.disableConfirm: Disable this team member's access? Their existing session will lose database access.
settings.initialOwner: The final active owner cannot be disabled or demoted.
settings.scope: These permissions apply to the selected business unit.

errors.generic: We couldn't save this change. Please try again.
errors.not_allowlisted: This Google account is not approved for this workspace.
errors.auth_failed: Google sign-in could not be completed. Please try again with an approved account.
errors.setup_required: The workspace database connection has not been configured yet.
errors.not_allowed: Your account doesn't have access to this action.
errors.owner_required: This action requires an owner account.
errors.not_found: This record is no longer available.
errors.sold_sku_immutable: This SKU has been sold. Create a new SKU to change its price.
errors.ticket_prefix_locked: The ticket prefix is locked after the first ticket.
errors.last_owner: Keep at least one active owner in this business unit.
errors.event_not_active: Select an active event before registering an order.
errors.event_full: This event has reached its ticket capacity.
errors.items_required: Add at least one item to the order.
errors.customer_name_required: Enter a customer name for the ticket.
errors.payment_method_required: Choose how the order was paid.
errors.product_unavailable: A selected product is no longer available for this event.
errors.invalid_transition: That status change is not available. Refresh and try again.
errors.invalid_ticket: Choose an available ticket from this event.
errors.order_locked: Only Unpaid orders can be edited.
errors.last_order_item: Cancel the order instead of removing its last item.
errors.invalid_request: Check the entered details and try again.
errors.duplicate: This SKU, email or mapping already exists.
errors.scope_immutable: Records cannot be moved between business units or events.
errors.load_failed: The latest data could not be loaded. Please try again.
errors.print_failed: The print request could not be recorded. Try again before printing.
errors.price_changed: A product price changed. Refresh and review the order before continuing.
